context.body: The exit mirrors the earlier entry: Noah moves when addressed rather than when he first sees dry ground.

observations.body: God tells Noah to leave with his household and bring out every living creature so life can multiply on earth.
observations.label: Noah leaves when God commands: action

observations.body: Noah, his family, and the creatures leave after their families.

payload.posture: Read Genesis 8:15–19 as remembered and restored evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The earth is visibly dry before Noah leaves, but the narrative still waits for God’s command.
